name: sfizz
author: gmorb (MPC port); sfizz by sfztools
summary: The sfizz 1.2.3 SFZ engine: plays SFZ libraries from SD cards and USB drives, streamed from disk, with key switches, the instrument's own CC controls, Scala tuning and up to Sinc 72 interpolation, on a one-page screen modelled on sfizz's editor. Gen1 and Gen2 builds.
